headline: A 2021 law awards a Congressional Gold Medal, posthumously, to the 13 service members killed at Kabul's Hamid Karzai International Airport on August 26, 2021.
what_it_does: The law authorizes a Congressional Gold Medal to honor the 13 service members who died on August 26, 2021, while stationed at Hamid Karzai International Airport in Afghanistan. Because the award is given after their deaths, it is presented posthumously. The title also notes the medal commemorates the evacuation of U.S. citizens and Afghan allies during that period.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 16, 2021.
